entities.name: Beauford H. Jester
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Beauford Halbert Jester was an American politician who served as the 36th governor of Texas from 1947 until his death in office in 1949. He is the only Texas governor ever to have died in office. Jester was a veteran of World War I and known for reforms of prisons and the educational system of the state.
